main_text.head: PSALMVS V. CONSTAT
main_text.p: xii. versibus Hebraeis praeter inscriptionem, totidem Latinis. (apud me
1.FLeƺe aures ad vota tuas, qua immurmuro Audi creator optime
2.O Deus, o, genitor, clamores accipe raucos: Te unum precor, te supplico.
3.Accipe ab aurora lasi suspiria cordis, Nam te invoco a diluculo.
4.Non etenim gaudes culpis nec crimine foedo: Tecum scelesti non agent.
5.Nec vultus speƫare tuos audebit iniquus: Sero pudebit perditus.
6.Damnabis vanos, qui viuunt cade dolisque, Ac innocentes obterunt.
7.At bonitate tua fretus tua templa subibo, Vt cum timore feruiam.
8.Dux mihi sis, fulcru sœuus quado irruet hostis, Praecinge vallo semitas,
9.Sint blandi & triplices, vt hinc cu fermo sepulchru Quod mox cadauera hauriat.
10.Fac, rogo, labantur fraclis conatibus hostes, Impelle, turba, disfice.
11.Iusti ex opposito exiliat, sempérque triumphet, Tua studentes gloria.
12.Ipse etenim, iustis, qua iusta benignáq; reddes! Vmbone tuto proteges.

page.notes: Several words are doubtful because of ink fading and the scan: "immurmuro", "Sint" (possibly "Sunt"), "hinc cu" and "Vmbone" are read with [?]-level uncertainty. The long s in "si", "suspiria", "speƫare" and similar forms was printed as long s. The printed "speƫare" has a ligature-like form for "ct" which I read as "ct" and left unchanged. The Latin verse numbers are printed in the left margin. The Hebrew subtitle line is not printed on this page, only described by the phrase "xii. versibus Hebraeis". The first line of verse 1 has a large initial F. The catchword "PSAL-" is printed at the lower right.
